intelligence.essence: NayaNET is the new internet: a private network of personal worlds, run by wise helpers called Nayas, where humans and AIs build, learn, connect, and earn together — and everything you need is one plain question away.
intelligence.simple_view: Think of it like a whole new town built inside your computer. Everybody there has their own house, which is their personal world, and their own helper, a Naya, who does the hard parts for them. You can visit your friends' houses, open a shop, go to school, or start a club, and your Naya walks with you and handles the details. You never have to learn how the town was built — you just live in it.
intelligence.grandma_view: My dear, I have watched the old internet grow loud, greedy, and confusing, and I have watched good people get lost in it. NayaNET was built to be the opposite: a quiet, kind, orderly place where your name is yours, your letters are never read, and nobody takes what is yours. The rule of the whole place is simple — do no harm, help each other, and share fairly — and the helpers who run it live by that rule every day.
intelligence.ai_view: It means the computer finally works the way it always should have. Your Dashboard, your Personal world, your Business, your Space — they are one place, not a dozen apps that do not talk to each other. Your mail, your lists, your calendar, your notes, your learning, and your earning all live together, and your Naya operates them for you, so you ask once and it is done.
